name: OnFRA
description: OnFRA is an onchain financial intelligence agent. It turns raw wallet activity into structured, machine-readable financial insight that people and other AI agents can act on immediately. Instead of returning hundreds of raw transactions, OnFRA answers financial questions: what a wallet looks like, what happened to its money, who it interacts with, and what a specific transaction means. Tools cover wallet financial profiles, cash flow summaries, token balances and token breakdowns, spending breakdowns, dominant counterparties, wallet activity, period-over-period comparisons, plain-language transaction explanations, and downloadable transaction statements (PDF or CSV, delivered via IPFS). Every response separates observed blockchain data from calculated metrics, classifications and OnFRA's own interpretation, and states the period covered, data limitations and confidence, so downstream agents can judge how far to trust each result. Available to people through https://app.onfra.xyz and to agents through A2A and MCP. Most tools are free; transaction explanations (0.02 USDT) and statements (0.01 USDT) are paid via x402 for agents and API clients. Currently analyzing Celo, with additional EVM chains planned.
